name: Dual Gun Reflex
summary:
Experience Dualgun Reflex, a high-octane mixed-reality shooter designed exclusively for Meta Quest. In this stationary VR game, you’ll dual-wield a red gun in your left hand and a blue gun in your right, facing waves of color-coded enemies that appear dynamically in your real environment. Your reflexes are your greatest weapon—shoot the right color, dodge slow-moving projectiles, and survive each escalating wave of combat.
